prompt.project_info: Create a four-panel sportswear editorial grid with one consistent adult model in a dark-blue studio with concrete blocks.
prompt.main_subject: One adult fictional woman with original non-celebrity features, braided dark hair, wearing a yellow, orange, and black graphic tracksuit with chunky generic sneakers. Maintain the same face, outfit, body proportions, and color grade throughout.
prompt.composition_elements: Four panels: seated back on a concrete cube looking down; close-up with arms crossed and direct gaze; squatting on a concrete cube looking up; seated on a concrete cube with legs apart and gaze to the side. Dark blue studio and concrete blocks remain consistent.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Controlled dark-blue studio lighting with sculptural shadows on concrete, crisp tracksuit color, athletic editorial atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Four-panel grid, consistent dimensions and styling, photorealistic fashion-sports photography, natural anatomy, sharp fabric and sneaker texture, no logos or text.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Four-panel sportswear fashion grid of one adult fictional woman with original non-celebrity features, braided dark hair, wearing a yellow, orange, and black graphic tracksuit with chunky generic sneakers. Same face, outfit, proportions, studio, and color grade in all panels. Top left seated back on a concrete cube looking down; top right close-up with arms crossed looking directly forward; bottom left squatting on a concrete cube looking up; bottom right seated on a cube with legs apart looking to the side. Consistent dark-blue studio, concrete blocks, controlled sculptural lighting, sharp photorealistic sportswear editorial detail.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor or underage appearance, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, blurry, low quality, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, deformed hands, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, text, signature
